summary: FD_ED_TC_22_System | DDS Service Down Mid-Flow | Graceful Error | Case Created for Retry
title: System | DDS Service Down Mid-Flow | Graceful Error | Case Created for Retry
description:
Customer completes identification, authentication, passenger/journey selection, but DDS service goes down during eligibility assessment. System must handle gracefully, create a case for retry, and notify customer.

Prerequisites:
DDS service: will go DOWN during eligibility assessment; All other services operational; Customer has completed identification and authentication
